summary: Implementation Plan for enhancing the booking confirmation page UI/UX. Redesigns the single large receipt ticket card into a grid of 4 beautifully tailored glassmorphism status boxes (Confirmation Code, Matched Provider, Scheduled Time, and Estimated Cost). Adds a premium button 'Show Agent Execution Steps' that triggers an interactive bottom drawer displaying a step-by-step timeline of all the coordinated agent tasks. Modifies the Traces API to support fetching historical agent logs using a booking ID, ensuring historical bookings can also render their exact agent pipeline traces.
